summary: Add one-press Emergency Shark Siren to mitigation panel
description: Lifeguards need to trigger a zone-wide beach evacuation instantly when a shark is detected in the water. The current mitigation panel requires navigating three sub-menus before the siren can be activated — an unacceptable delay when every second counts. This ticket tracks adding a single, prominent Emergency Shark Siren button directly to the top-level mitigation panel UI. Tapping it must dispatch the siren to all buoy speakers and send evacuation alerts to all registered devices within the zone in under 500ms. Acceptance criteria: (1) siren button visible on first render without scrolling; (2) single tap triggers full evacuation flow; (3) confirmation toast appears within 200ms; (4) action is logged with GPS timestamp for incident review.

comments.author: Jake Torres
comments.body: Spoke with the lifeguard team — they want a big red button, unmissable. No confirmation dialog for the siren itself, as hesitation costs lives.

comments.author: Maya Chen
comments.body: Agreed. I'll put it at the top of the panel with a 56dp tap target. We'll add a brief haptic pulse on Android so even in panic the user gets feedback.
